{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts overshoot current prices by 0.5-1.0 on days 1-3 then converge to within 0.3 by day 5",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price changes: high sentiment (0.67+): price up 0.3-0.6; low sentiment: price stable or down",
    "Price mean-reversion: model deviates from recent trend more than 1.0 on first 10 days, then corrects to within 0.5 of history",
    "Forecast lag: model responds to sentiment changes with 1-2 day delay, causing 24-48 hour lag in price predictions",
    "Sentiment strength matters: weak sentiment (0.33-0.50) predicts 20-30% smaller price moves than strong sentiment (0.67+)",
    "Model overconfident on extremes: at price highs (72+), model predicts 10-15% more upside than realistic (0.5-0.8x actual)",
    "Underestimates volatility on sentiment shifts: when sentiment moves sharply, model smooths too much, missing 30-40% of true volatility"
] }
